decisions.rationale: dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across 166158 rows, confirming whole rows are distinct; flight_date (181 distinct), carrier_code (16 distinct), flight_number (2994 distinct), and origin_airport (3 distinct) all have null_rate 0.0 and together form the smallest plausible natural key for a scheduled flight leg; unverified until a deterministic measurement confirms it against the warehouse.

aircraft_manufacturer, aircraft_model, aircraft_seat_count, and aircraft_engine_type share null_rate 0.160426 (26656 nulls), and aircraft_manufacture_year has null_rate 0.176531 (29332 nulls); these appear to be a tail-number lookup that fails for some aircraft and are kept nullable rather than required.

dest_airport_name, dest_municipality, dest_iso_region, dest_elevation_ft, and dest_longest_runway_ft all share null_rate 0.02089 (3471 nulls), consistent with a destination airport reference lookup that does not resolve for every dest_airport code; kept nullable.

captured_at carries 16 distinct timestamp values clustered within one minute on 2026-09-02, unlike any business date in the table (flight_date ranges 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30); this matches an ingestion/load timestamp even though is_airbyte_metadata is recorded false, so it is retained and documented rather than dropped.

dep_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes (null_rate 0.029388), arr_hhmm (0.0307), and arr_delay_minutes, air_time_minutes (0.032981) show similar small null rates that likely correspond to cancelled or diverted flights flagged by is_cancelled, but the profile does not cross-tabulate these columns so the correlation is not confirmed.

purpose: This table holds one row per scheduled flight departing a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) between 2013-01-01 and 2013-06-30, recording the flight's schedule, actual departure and arrival performance, the operating aircraft's attributes, and origin/destination airport reference data.
usage: Read the table at the grain of flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, and origin_airport: each row is one scheduled flight leg. Use is_cancelled and the presence of dep_hhmm/arr_hhmm to identify completed versus cancelled flights, and join carrier_code to carrier_name and the airport codes to their name/municipality/elevation/runway reference columns for display purposes.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm that the proposed grain uniquely identifies rows; that requires a deterministic measurement against the warehouse. The aircraft lookup columns (manufacturer, model, year, seat_count, engine_type) and the destination airport reference columns are null for a meaningful share of rows (16.0% and 2.1% respectively) because their source lookups do not resolve for every tail_number or dest_airport; this is not a data quality defect in this table but a limitation of the upstream reference data. captured_at appears to be a pipeline ingestion timestamp despite is_airbyte_metadata being recorded false, and is retained per rule 1 rather than dropped; a reviewer should confirm whether it belongs in this contract or should be reclassified as metadata. Several string columns were truncated at the profiler's character cap in parts of the payload; any truncated sample was treated as a prefix only, not a complete value.
